title: group_invite — input
description: Input schema for the SOX group_invite operation. Invites an agent to a group. The calling agent MUST be an active member of the group. The invited agent's membership status is set to 'invited'. The optional message is delivered to the invited agent via the sox-invite.schema.json envelope. Normative reference: spec/primitives/groups.md §5.2.

group_id.description: The full group channel name including the 'group/' prefix (e.g. 'group/eng-team').

agent_id.description: The agent to invite. Must be a known agent identity in the current namespace.

message.description: Optional invitation message sent to the invited agent via the sox-invite.schema.json envelope. Free text in v1.0.

examples.message: Please join the security review group for sprint 42.
